value.name: Asha inspects Marcus's untouched belongings
value.description: Asha examines the closet and notices Marcus left behind his work gear and wallet, suggesting he departed without taking anything.
evidence: lunch pail, hard hat, the orange high-visibility vest she had heard him mention on the call, none of it gone with him
his wallet sat flat against the wood
the orderly stillness of a man who had taken nothing with him

value.name: Asha searches for signs of foul play
value.description: She looks for evidence of violence or disturbance that might explain Marcus's absence, but finds nothing suspicious.
evidence: She crouched and looked for the things she did not want to find, a stain, a torn sleeve, a gap in the row of work boots

value.name: Claire silently reacts to the discovery
value.description: Claire exhales audibly, revealing she has been waiting for someone else to confront the closet and say what it means.
evidence: Behind her Claire's breath went out audibly, once

the question she had come here to answer was not which of the three things Marcus had done but how long Claire had been sitting at that table waiting for someone else to look at this closet and say it out loud

value.name: Asha opens Marcus's wallet
value.description: Asha lifts Marcus's wallet from the shelf and opens it to inspect its contents under the light.
evidence: Asha reached up and lifted the wallet from the shelf
She thumbed it open where she stood, angling it toward the bare bulb above the closet

value.name: Asha finds wallet contents and no note
value.description: Inside the wallet, Asha finds identification, cash, and a recent diesel receipt, but no note left behind.
evidence: the license still in its sleeve, two twenties folded flat behind a credit card, a receipt for diesel from a station off Route 1 dated four days ago, no note tucked anywhere a man would tuck a note if he meant one to be found

value.name: Asha returns the wallet carefully
value.description: She closes the wallet and replaces it exactly where it was, preserving the original arrangement before turning back to Claire.
evidence: She closed it with both hands and set it back exactly where it had been, lining the worn corner up with the faint shadow it had left on the wood
and only then did she turn to face Claire
